description: Searchable quick-reference cards for common first-aid situations: CPR, choking, bleeding, burns, and more.

faqs.a: Type in the search box — cards filter instantly. Tap a card to expand its step-by-step instructions.
faqs.q: How do I use this reference?

faqs.a: No — it is a memory aid for trained responders, not a substitute for professional training or emergency care.
Call your local emergency number immediately (e.g. 911, 112, 15 in Pakistan) before doing anything else.
faqs.q: What is the first thing to do in an emergency?

howto: Search for the situation (e.g. choking, burns).
Tap a card to expand its steps.
Follow the steps while help is on the way.
Call emergency services first in any real emergency.
title: First Aid Reference
